notes.title: Minor bug fix
notes.notes:
We fixed a bug that affected the sound effects. Sometimes, the first collected coin in a level wouldn't play its sound.

This should we working as expected, now.

notes.title: Bug fixes!!
notes.notes: [p]Hello! Hope you're doing well.[/p][p][/p][p]We've released a small update to fix two bugs:[/p][list][*][p][b]Sound Effects:[/b] sound effects played even when the game was paused. From now on, they will pause and resume when the game does![/p][/*][*][p][b]Explosive Platforms:[/b] Do you remember the last fix we published for explosive platforms? Well, it broke something else. Massi couldn't trigger their explosion when touching the platform with her head or body. We've fixed this, too![/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks a lot for your support.[/p]

notes.title: Cloud Saves Fix - Get the latest update!
notes.notes:
Hello!

The demo had an issue with Cloud Saves. It seems that Steam didn't recognize the format of the save files. So, in this update:
[list]
[*] Reworked Save / Load System
[*] Fixed Steam Cloud Saves
[/list]

Make sure you have the latest update installed. Now available for both Windows and Mac.

Thanks for your support!!
